name: Reparametrized Integral Gradients
definition: A method that reparametrizes relevant integrals (including pixel integrals over spherical domains) to remove dependency on scene parameters, thereby eliminating discontinuities during parameter changes.
summary: Reparametrized Integral Gradients eliminates gradient bias from moving visibility discontinuities by warping the integration domain to fix discontinuity locations, avoiding explicit boundary sampling.
